form.label: Saved CVEs
form.description: A watchlist of CVEs you are tracking, saved with their announcement date and vulnerable version ranges. Re-run the query or rescan a group of servers (by environment and application) at any time, from here or with the Splunk search commands shown at the bottom.

panel.title: Watchlist (click a CVE to rescan by group)

search.query: | r7cvewatch action=list with_counts=true include_closed=$closed$ | table cve software ranges announced rapid7_check affected_now prod_dc prod_dr non_prod confirmed_affected unknown fixed_since_saved status saved_by saved_at | rename prod_dc as "Prod · DC" prod_dr as "Prod · DR" non_prod as "Non-prod"
| r7cvewatch action=add cve=$new_cve|s$ announced=$new_announced|s$ software=$new_software|s$ ranges=$new_ranges|s$ | eval nonce=$save_nonce|s$ | fields - nonce
| r7cve cve=$cve|s$ | mvexpand appname | stats count by appname | where appname!=""
| r7cve cve=$cve|s$ env=$env|s$ app=$app|s$ | stats count as servers by env_label verdict | sort env_label verdict

button.data-r7-confirm: Launch the Rapid7 rescan for this group?

search.query: | r7rescan cve=$cve|s$ env=$env|s$ app=$app|s$ scope=$scope$ dryrun=true
| r7rescan cve=$cve|s$ env=$env|s$ app=$app|s$ scope=$scope$ dryrun=false request_id=$launch_nonce|s$ launched_from="Saved CVEs"

td.code: | r7cvewatch action=add cve=CVE-2026-20517 announced=2026-11-18 software="PHP" ranges="8.1 < 8.1.34 ; 8.2 < 8.2.29 ; 8.3 < 8.3.27"
| r7cve cve=CVE-2026-20517 env="Prod · DC,Prod · DR" app="Payments API"

tr.td: Read only; nothing is sent to Rapid7.

td.code: | r7rescan cve=CVE-2026-20517 env="Non-prod" app="Customer portal" dryrun=true

tr.td: Sites, servers, skipped and why. Add detail=true for one row per server.

td.code: | r7rescan cve=CVE-2026-20517 env="Non-prod" app="Customer portal" dryrun=false

tr.td: Returns the job ID. Needs role rapid7_cve_rescan; max 50 servers.
Scan status while running; before/after per server when finished.
Version-only check for a CVE Rapid7 has no check for yet.

html.p: env= accepts a group (Prod, Non-prod) or a label (Prod · DC, Prod · DR, Non-prod · UAT / SIT / DEV), comma-separated.
